objetivo: Back-row defence, setting and a controlled cross-court attack from 4 in a continuous rally.
descripcion: Full court, continuous rally, no block and no scoring for now. The waiting line stands outside the court, behind the end line near zone 6.
rolesFijos:
Setters: zone 2, one on each court.
Liberos: zone 5, one on each court.
rotan: 8 players. Waiting line → come in at 6 → (dig) → move to 4 → cross-court attack → waiting line of the other court.
secuencia:
The coach attacks onto court A from outside court B (only to start the rally).
The players at 4, 5 and 6 defend; whoever the ball goes to digs.
The setter sets to zone 4.
Controlled cross-court attack from 4, no block.
The same happens on the other court, continuous rally.
rotacion:
The player at 4 changes court outside the net and joins the waiting line on the other side.
The player at 6 moves to 4 (defends near the 3 m line).
The first player in the waiting line comes in at 6.

objetivo: Back-row and front-zone defence, setting and a controlled attack from 4 or from 2 in a continuous rally.
descripcion: Full court, continuous rally, no block and no scoring for now. The waiting line stands outside the court, behind zone 6. You choose the attack zone (4 or 2) and the direction (cross-court or down the line). Attacking from 4: rotating players at 1, 6 and 4 plus a libero at 5; the path is waiting line → 1 → 6 → 4 → attack → waiting line of the other court. Attacking from 2: rotating players at 6, 1 and 2 plus a libero at 5, with zone 4 empty; the path is waiting line → 6 → 1 → 2 → attack → waiting line of the other court.
rolesFijos:
Setter (one per court): starts between 2 and 3, penetrates to set and always looks at 4. Attack from 4: front set. Attack from 2: back set.
Libero (one per court): zone 5.
rotan: 8 players: 3 on court per side and 1 in the waiting line.
secuencia:
The coach attacks onto court A from outside court B (only to start the rally).
Whoever the ball goes to digs.
The setter penetrates from between 2 and 3 and sets to the attack zone.
Controlled attack in the chosen direction, no block.
The same happens on the other court, continuous rally.
rotacion:
The attacker changes court outside the net, by the post on her side, and joins the waiting line of the other court.
The other two rotating players move up one spot along the path.
The first player in the waiting line comes in at the entry zone (1 when attacking from 4, 6 when attacking from 2).
If the waiting line is empty, the player arriving from the other court goes straight to the entry zone.

objetivo: Warm up ball control: attack, dig and set in a continuous 1 vs 1 exchange across the net.
descripcion: Twelve players in six pairs, one player on each side of the net. Both players take turns attacking, digging and setting. The attack is a controlled hit with no jump, aimed at the partner. No scoring.
rolesFijos: Pairs: A on one side of the net, B on the other.
secuencia:
A attacks to B (controlled hit, no jump).
B digs to A.
A sets to B.
B attacks to A.
A digs to B.
B sets to A and the sequence repeats.
rotacion: No rotation: each pair stays in its lane.
progresiones: Version with 3 players: after attacking, the player moves to the other line.

objetivo: Warm up ball control and the full attack chain: dig, self set and attack, one player at a time.
descripcion: Twelve players in six pairs, one player on each side of the net. Each player makes three touches in a row (dig, set to self, attack) before the ball goes to the partner. The attack is a controlled hit with no jump. No scoring.
rolesFijos: Pairs: A on one side of the net, B on the other.
secuencia:
A attacks to B (controlled hit, no jump).
B digs, sets to self and attacks to A.
A digs, sets to self and attacks to B.
The sequence repeats.
rotacion: No rotation: each pair stays in its lane.
progresiones: Version with 3 players: after attacking, the player moves to the other line.

objetivo: Warm up the attacker and the dig-and-set sequence with fixed roles.
descripcion: Twelve players in six pairs, one player on each side of the net. A only attacks; B digs and then sets back to A. The attack is a controlled hit with no jump. No scoring.
rolesFijos: A attacks. B digs and sets.
secuencia:
A attacks to B (controlled hit, no jump).
B digs and sets back to A.
A attacks again and the sequence repeats.
rotacion: No rotation: each pair stays in its lane.
